cards.text: Jesus is still up on the mountain, teaching His disciples (Matthew 5:1-2). Now He gets to righteous acts, and He opens with a warning: be careful not to do them in front of people just to be seen.

cards.question: Jesus says if you do your righteous acts to be seen by men, what reward do you get from your Father in heaven?

cards.text: First up is giving to the needy, and Jesus says not to sound a trumpet before you like the hypocrites do. Picture dropping a twenty in the tip jar and then waiting for the whole line to clap.

cards.question: Why do the hypocrites sound a trumpet when they give to the needy?

cards.text: Jesus says, 'Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.' They got the crowd's applause, friend, and THAT was the whole paycheck.
So when you give, Jesus says, don't let your left hand know what your right hand is doing. Friend, my mustache is my hands, and both sides of it gossip like a group chat.

cards.question: Jesus says not to let your left hand know what your right hand is doing when you give. What's the point of that picture?

answers.text: So you give with both hands
So you give a little at a time

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says the Father sees giving that's done in secret and will reward it.

cards.text: Next up is prayer, and Jesus says don't be like the hypocrites. They love to pray standing where people will see them.

cards.question: Where does Jesus say the hypocrites love to stand and pray?

answers.text: In the synagogues and on street corners
In the temple courts and the marketplaces
At the town wells and the city squares

cards.text: Then Jesus says that line again: 'Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.' So where SHOULD you pray?

cards.question: When you pray, Jesus says to go into your ___ room.
True or false: Jesus says to keep the door open when you pray in your inner room.

cards.text: Same promise as with giving: 'And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.' I spent years in a dark drawer, friend, and trust me, the dark is NOT where God stops seeing.
One more prayer warning: don't babble on like pagans. You know, like a guy explaining his problem to customer service for the ninth time.

cards.question: Jesus says pagans think that by their many ___ they will be ___.
True or false: Jesus says the Father only knows what you need once you ask Him.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, 'So then, this is how you should pray…' and He gives a prayer to follow. After all that talk about babbling, friend, this one gets right to it.

cards.question: True or false: the prayer Jesus gives opens by talking to God as 'Our Father in heaven'.

cards.text: Next come the words 'hallowed be Your name' and 'Your kingdom come'. Notice that, friend: God's name and God's kingdom go FIRST, before we ask for one thing for ourselves.

cards.question: True or false: the prayer asks for God's will to be done in heaven but not on earth.

cards.text: Then the prayer turns from God's kingdom to what we need right now. The big stuff AND the everyday stuff, friend, all in one prayer with no second appointment needed.

cards.question: In the prayer Jesus gives, what does it ask God to give us this day?

cards.text: Not a whole pantry, friend, just this day. Then the prayer turns to our debts.

cards.question: The prayer asks God to ___ us our debts, as we also have ___ our debtors.

cards.text: Then the prayer asks God not to lead us into temptation. And friend, it closes out with one more request.

cards.question: At the end of the prayer, what does it ask God to deliver us from?

cards.text: Right after the prayer, Jesus says, 'For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.'

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says that if you don't forgive men their trespasses, your Father will still forgive yours.

cards.text: Now Jesus gets to fasting, and the warning sounds familiar: don't be somber like the hypocrites.

cards.question: Jesus says the hypocrites disfigure their faces to show ___ they are fasting.

cards.text: And for the third time, Jesus says, 'Truly I tell you, they already have their full reward.' Trumpet guy, street-corner guy, sad-face guy: same receipt.

cards.question: So when you fast, what does Jesus tell you to do?

answers.text: Anoint your head and wash your face
Put ashes on your head and weep
Tear your robe and cover your face

cards.question: Jesus says to anoint your head and wash your face when you fast. Why?

answers.text: So your fasting isn't obvious to men
So you stay clean for the temple
So you feel fresh while you go without

cards.text: And that line one more time: 'And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.' Jesus isn't done preaching yet, friend, so keep that apron on.
